summary: Western Union filed an 8-K disclosing regulatory developments in its pending acquisition of International Money Express (IMXI). On August 13, 2026, Western Union and Intermex entered an Assurance of Discontinuance with the NYAG and commitments with NYDFS, resolving competition concerns for NY remittance routes to Latin America/Caribbean. Commitments include maintaining retail footprint, service continuity, price limits, reporting, and prior approval for acquisitions for three years post-close, plus an independent auditor. California DFPI suspended its approval extension. The merger is progressing with regulatory conditions, signaling likely near-term closing; watch for DFPI resolution and final approvals.
